description: Release notes from a GitHub repo: compares two refs (default: latest tag to HEAD), reads every commit and changed file, and writes grouped notes (Breaking changes, Features, Fixes, Performance, Docs, Internal) with PR numbers, a semver bump recommendation and a ready-to-paste markdown body, plus the raw commit list. Public repos; private with your GITHUB token on the operator side. $0.015. Costs $0.015 USDC per call (x402).
